findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dynamic eval/exec in Pillow
 * @description Use of eval or exec with non-constant argument may allow code injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pillow-eval
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-095
 */
import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(0) and
  not arg.asExpr() instanceof StrConst
select call, "Dynamic call to " + call.getFunction().toString() + " with non-literal input"
findings.hypothesis: Pillow uses eval/exec on non-constant data (e.g. ImageMath.eval, PdfParser), enabling code injection

Dynamic call to ControlFlowNode for exec with non-literal input

findings.hypothesis: ImageMath.eval() passes its expression argument to eval() without sanitization, allowing code injection (CVE-2023-50447, fixed in 10.2.0).

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name subprocess calls with shell=True
 * @description Passing a command string to a subprocess with shell=True can allow shell injection (CWE-78).
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pillow-shell-true
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node cmd
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "check_output", "Popen", "check_call"]).getACall() and
  exists(DataFlow::Node sh |
    sh = call.getArgByName("shell") and
    sh.asExpr().(Name).getId() = "True"
  ) and
  cmd = call.getArg(0)
select call, "subprocess call with shell=True and command $@", cmd, "argument"
findings.hypothesis: Command injection via subprocess shell=True in EpsImagePlugin (Ghostscript invocation) — CWE-78

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dangerous calls in Pillow library code
 * @description Inventory of unsafe API usage in src/PIL (CWE-377, CWE-78, CWE-22).
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pillow-dangerous-api
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, string what
where
  call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/PIL/%") and
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall() and what = "os shell command"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "check_output", "Popen", "check_call", "getoutput"]).getACall() and what = "subprocess"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("mktemp").getACall() and what = "insecure temp file (mktemp)"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember("ZipFile").getMember("extractall").getACall() and what = "zip extraction (possible zip slip)"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("tarfile").getMember("TarFile").getMember("extractall").getACall() and what = "tar extraction (possible path traversal)"
    or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() and what = "exec"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() and what = "pickle load"
    or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() and what = "marshal load"
  )
select call, what
findings.hypothesis: Pillow library code may invoke shell commands, use insecure temp files, or extract archives unsafely.

/**
 * @name ImageMath.eval reachable with non-literal expression from image data
 * @description ImageMath.eval evaluates a string expression; when fed untrusted input it allows code execution (CWE-94).
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/pillow-imagemath-eval-sink
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode c, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  c = API::builtin("eval").getACall()
  and arg = c.getArg(0)
  and c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/PIL/%")
select c, "eval() invoked in library code on non-literal expression $@", arg, "expression"
findings.hypothesis: Confirm the exact set of eval() sinks inside src/PIL and whether the argument is dynamic (ImageMath CVE-2023-50447)

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Dynamic import / attribute access with non-literal input
 * @description Using __import__/importlib with attacker-controlled module names can load unexpected code (CWE-470).
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/pillow-dyn-import
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-470
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode c, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  (
    c = API::builtin("__import__").getACall() or
    c = API::moduleImport("importlib").getMember(["import_module", "__import__"]).getACall()
  ) and
  arg = c.getArg(0) and
  not exists(arg.asExpr().(StrConst)) and
  c.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().matches("src/PIL/%")
select c, "Dynamic import with non-literal module name."
findings.hypothesis: Dynamic module import with attacker-controlled name in library code
